**Apply request options to the voice-name lookup in `speak`.** When `speak` uses the default voice `"Callum"`, the ElevenLabs wrapper resolves that name by calling `voices.getAll` before it generates speech. In `elevenlabs@1.59.0`, `generate` does not pass `requestOptions` to that lookup. The lookup therefore uses SDK default timeout and retry settings instead of the configured values. Resolve the voice name in the provider with `this.requestOptions`, then pass the resolved voice ID to `generate` with the same options. Add a test that covers the name-resolution path. The current `generate` mock does not exercise the lookup.
